name: render-failure-matrix
proves: fail-closed render behavior for missing/mismatched implementations, ABI mismatch, unsupported slot rendering — with the exact codes and never a silent fallback

cases.case: instance revision pin matches no registered descriptor revision (compile-side falsifier for the B-1 repair)

compiled.note: node pinned revision '7'; registered descriptors carry revision '1' only

cases.expectedBehavior: compile fails closed; no instruction is emitted; the id-keyed last-wins descriptor map must not silently resolve the un-pinned revision

cases.case: two implementations match the identity (competing registration)
implementation revision differs from the descriptor revision
old plan artifact: instruction for an abi@1 descriptor without outputDecls (pre-amendment compiler output)

compiled.note: NO outputDecls field - the legacy extension-instruction shape (propDecls/propValues only, verified at 952d92d); the new compiler always emits outputDecls for abi@1 descriptors

cases.expectedBehavior: fail-closed at the new renderer - the silent-degradation hole is closed; a pre-amendment plan can never present an apparently functional control with lost output wiring

cases.case: declared+filled slot the implementation ABI cannot render

cases.runtime: implementation emits checkedChange after save/reload replaced the plan; occurrence unmounted; emit from a superseded revision instance
cases.expectedBehavior: dropped at the generation gate; dev-only diagnostic; no state write, no dispatch

cases.runtime: implementation calls emit('toggled') or emit('checkedChange', 'truthy-string') against payload boolean
cases.expectedBehavior: dropped by the bridge before any binding resolution; dev-only diagnostic
